> [!WARNING]
> This preview contains **ad-hoc signed, unnotarized** macOS artifacts. Apple
> cannot verify their developer identity, so Gatekeeper will block the first
> launch. Only continue if you trust this repository and have verified the
> download. After attempting to open OpsCapsule, follow [Apple's instructions]
> to approve it under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

This preview supports Apple Silicon Macs (`arm64`). It is not a production-ready
release: Developer ID signing, notarization, auto-update metadata, Windows and
Linux artifacts, and a full security review remain future work.

Download either the DMG or ZIP and verify it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. GitHub
build provenance is also attached to both application artifacts.

[Apple's instructions]: https://support.apple.com/102445
